record.reason: AgentWatcher attributes output-relevant context spans and applies a rule-based monitor; restricting the monitor to a small context is intended to scale detection to long contexts and cut monitor computation. The paper is a prompt-injection defense, not an inference-system optimization, and does not quantify general serving savings.
record.title: AgentWatcher: A Rule-based Prompt Injection Monitor
